decisions.reason: The hearty loaf is a low-cost extension of the core bread assortment on existing lines, and with a growing industry there is no shortfall against aspirations to prompt search for other uses of its resources.

The mill tour supports the heritage and experience positioning and uses existing event facilities, so despite pandemic-related uncertainty for hospitality the firm's slack lets it carry the tour rather than abandon a distinctive offer.
The farmhouse bread sits close to the established offer with minimal incremental cost, and there is no evidence of underperformance that would trigger problemistic search.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is presented as a flagship and exceeds aspiration levels set by comparable bakeries, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The premium stollen also won gold and serves the lucrative seasonal gift business, so its results meet or exceed aspirations and justify keeping it.
